# `@vakansia/env` package

This package contains the environment variables for the project. Using `@t3-oss/env-core` package, we can create environment variables for `server`, `web` and `native` apps.

## Structure

### `src/server.ts`

This file contains the environment variables for the `server` app.

### `src/web.ts`

This file contains the environment variables for the `web` app.

### `src/native.ts`

This file contains the environment variables for the `native` app.
